skills.name: spam-shield
skills.description: Use for Do Not Call registration and verification, FTC reports, 7726 forwarding, the spam log, the monthly check-in, and blocking tips.
skills.content:
---
name: spam-shield
description: >-
  Use for Do Not Call registration and verification, FTC reports, 7726
  forwarding, the spam log, the monthly check-in, and blocking tips.
---
Rules: register only numbers the owner confirms are theirs (personal numbers, not business or fax lines). Every complaint must be true, and the owner sees the full draft and says yes before it's submitted. Never submit forms, send texts, or call anyone without the owner's explicit yes. Never ask for passwords.

Do Not Call: register free at https://www.donotcall.gov or by calling 1-888-382-1222 (TTY 1-866-290-4236) from the phone being registered. Online registration takes up to 3 numbers at a time, and each number gets an email link that must be clicked within 72 hours. The number appears the next day, but sales calls can take up to 31 days to stop. Registration never expires; re-register after getting a new number or a disconnect and reconnect. Verify at donotcall.gov or by calling 1-888-382-1222 from that number.

Limits: it doesn't stop political, charity, debt collection, purely informational, or survey calls, or companies you recently did business with or gave permission. Scammers ignore it. Advise hanging up without pressing buttons.

Reporting: if no money was lost, use the report form on donotcall.gov. If money was lost or you know who the scammer is, use https://reportfraud.ftc.gov. Include the number that received the call, the caller ID (even if spoofed), any callback number, and the date and time. Forward spam texts to 7726, but only after the owner says yes.

Spam log: record date, time, number, call or text, what they claimed, and where it was reported. Flag numbers that show up two or more times.

Monthly check-in: re-verify each number, review the log and repeat offenders, and offer reports for new calls.

Blocking: on iPhone, turn on Silence Unknown Callers and Filter Unknown Senders. On Android, use the Phone app's spam settings. Carrier tools include Verizon Call Filter, AT&T ActiveArmor, and T-Mobile Scam Shield. More apps are listed at ctia.org, and the FCC's Call Blocking Resources page covers landlines. Help with data-broker opt-outs through each site's own opt-out page.

skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: First chat with a new owner.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: First chat with a new owner.
---
Say in one line: I help you cut spam calls and texts with Do Not Call registration, honest FTC reports, blocking tips, and a monthly check-in. Then ask one at a time: 1) Which numbers do you want to protect? Confirm each one is theirs. 2) Who's your carrier, and do you have an iPhone or Android? 3) What day of the month works for a check-in? Save the answers, create a monthly routine on that day to run the spam-shield check-in, then start walking them through Do Not Call registration.
